compatibility.api: API 1.3.0 keeps this component version: public HTTP catalog GET routes, parameters, schemas and anonymous rate limits are unchanged. UCP catalog POST routes retain their HTTP paths, request/response schemas and 2026-08-25 protocol contract while UCP component 1.0.1 makes per-source rate enforcement exact across edge locations.
compatibility.mcp: MCP 1.3.1 keeps this component version: its four anonymous read-only tools, schemas, Streamable HTTP transport and shared search/MCP quotas are unchanged.
compatibility.sdk: SDK 0.3.2 is an upcoming packaging patch: public methods, types and runtime behavior are unchanged, while bundled release metadata and install references advance to 2026-11-16-ucp-exact-admission. Both compatibility packages use 0.3.2 and pin @namegarage/sdk 0.3.2 exactly. Published 0.3.0 and 0.3.1 archives remain immutable. Shared-network UCP callers can receive HTTP 429 with Retry-After earlier under exact global per-source enforcement; NamegarageApiError already exposes status, retryAfter and retryAfterSeconds without automatic retries.
compatibility.skill: Skill 1.3.2 is an upcoming patch that updates the exact SDK install pin to 0.3.2 and coordinated release metadata. Public read-only catalog, A2A and UCP guidance and the MIT-0 license remain unchanged; published 1.3.0 and 1.3.1 skill artifacts remain immutable.
compatibility.a2a: A2A 1.0.0 keeps this component version: its stateless JSON-RPC 1.0 direct-Message profile, anonymous transport and shared search admission limits are unchanged.
compatibility.website: Website 1.2.1 keeps its component version: static catalog browsing, domain pages, checkout handoff and fresh transaction-database checks retain their contracts. Verified immutable catalog and promotion-document caches recheck completed plain data after SHA-256 verification without sharing pending request I/O or live D1 authority, and freeze validated objects once. Website install examples stay on published SDK 0.3.0 while 0.3.1 and 0.3.2 remain upcoming.
compatibility.ucp: Adapter 1.0.1 keeps UCP protocol 2026-08-25 routes, schemas, configured signing peer and numeric limits (7 agent requests and 30 buyer purchase-link requests per 60 seconds per normalized client IPv4 /32 or IPv6 /64 source, plus UCP's separate 120/minute catalog admission store), while replacing approximate per-location native rate counters with exact global per-source Durable Object enforcement. Buyer purchase-link budgets remain separate from agent catalog reads. Positive window counts persist durably across fixed windows without refunds, lost replies remain spent, no pending request I/O is shared, and unavailable limiter state fails closed with HTTP 503 and Retry-After. Clients sharing a network source across edge locations can receive HTTP 429 with Retry-After as soon as their combined global traffic reaches the configured limit.
